level.setting: A volatile volcanic realm where the earth itself seems to breathe with fury, surrounded by erupting mountains and rivers of fire.

pickup.name: Quake Stone
pickup.effect: Obtains Quake Stone, a powerful weapon that causes groundquakes, disrupting the enemy's balance.

encounters.trigger: Player activates a dormant magma flow, awakening the Lava Golem from a fissure.

pickup.name: Obsidian Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Obsidian Crystal, which can disrupt the energy of the Molten Sovereign.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Magma Serpent, the ground cracks open revealing a hidden chamber with the Obsidian Crystal.

pickup.name: Core Key
pickup.effect: Reveals the location of the Molten Sovereign's core and unlocks a path to the final confrontation.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Flame Warden triggers a seismic shockwave that opens the final chamber, leading to the Molten Sovereign.

boss.name: Molten Sovereign
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core of the Molten Sovereign by using the Obsidian Crystal obtained from the previous encounters.

level.objective: Reach the core of the volcano and destroy the Molten Sovereign using the Obsidian Crystal.
level.reward: Molten Sovereign's Core (used to fuel the player's geomantic abilities)

level.setting: A volatile volcanic realm filled with active lava flows, molten rock, and unstable terrain. The air is thick with ash and heat.

pickup.name: Fireblast Crystal
pickup.effect: Gains Fireblast ability

encounters.trigger: Cross the lava bridge

pickup.name: Flameforged Ember
pickup.effect: Gains Flameforged Ember

encounters.trigger: Trigger the magma core

pickup.name: Fireheart Shard
pickup.effect: Increases fire resistance by 25%

encounters.trigger: Destroy the soul obelisk

boss.name: Magma Serpent
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Magma Serpent by exploiting its vulnerability to the Flameforged Ember.

level.objective: Defeat the Magma Serpent and escape the volcanic realm.

level.setting: A molten volcanic region filled with active lava flows, unstable terrain, and ancient ruins of a forgotten order.

enemy.name: Magma Wraith
enemy.weakness: Firebrand Scepter (obtained later in the level)

pickup.name: Ashen Amulet
pickup.effect: Increases mana regeneration by 15%

encounters.trigger: Player reaches the magma pools at the cavern entrance.

pickup.name: Firebrand Scepter
pickup.effect: Unlocks a divine shield ability for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player activates the ancient lava conduit in the Obsidian Hall, awakening the champion.

pickup.name: Crystallized Ash
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of the player's health and mana

encounters.trigger: Player activates the ancient altar in the Ashen Sanctum, summoning the final guardian.

boss.name: Ashborn Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Ashborn Warden by exploiting its vulnerability to the Firebrand Scepter, obtained earlier in the level.

level.objective: Defeat the Ashborn Warden and escape the volcano with the Crystallized Ash.

level.theme: Brutal survival in a hostile, fiery world where every step could be the last.
level.setting: A desolate volcanic landscape filled with molten rivers, ash clouds, and unstable terrain. The air is thick with sulfur, and the ground trembles under the weight of the earth's fury.

encounters.hazard: Ash Cloud - Reduces player stamina regeneration by 33%

pickup.name: Firebrand Axe
pickup.effect: Firebrand Axe

encounters.trigger: Break the obsidian gate by destroying 3 molten pillars with the Firebrand Axe.

encounters.hazard: Lava Pools - Deal 50 damage per second if standing in them

pickup.name: Ember Core
pickup.effect: Ember Core

encounters.trigger: Recover the Ember Core by navigating the collapsing lava cavern and defeating the Lava Golem.

encounters.hazard: Magma Spikes - Instant death if touched

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Magma Sentinel to gain access to the final chamber and the Molten Leviathan.

boss.name: Molten Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Molten Leviathan by exploiting its weakness to the Ember Core.

level.objective: Survive the volcanic desolation and defeat the Molten Leviathan by using the Ember Core, acquired from the Lava Golem.
level.reward: Ember Core - A powerful energy source that can be used to weaken the Molten Leviathan.

level.setting: Volcanic Ruins - A mysterious, ancient volcanic site filled with magma flows, glowing crystals, and long-forgotten machines.

pickup.name: Thunderbolt
pickup.effect: Acquires Thunderbolt

encounters.trigger: Player steps on the cracked obsidian tile near the lava flow

pickup.name: Lava Catalyst
pickup.effect: Acquires Lava Catalyst

encounters.trigger: Player activates the dormant lava forge mechanism after defeating the Emberclaw

pickup.name: Seal of the Forge
pickup.effect: Unlocks access to the Boss Fight

encounters.trigger: Player defeats the Ashfang Sentinel and places the Lava Catalyst in the ancient forge

boss.name: Ashfang
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Ashfang by targeting its crystalline core with the Lava Catalyst

level.objective: Survive the volcanic terrain, acquire the necessary artifacts to weaken the Ashfang, and defeat it using the Lava Catalyst.

level.setting: A volcanic wasteland with molten rivers, unstable terrain, and eerie echoes of ancient power

pickup.name: Stormclaw Whirlwind
pickup.effect: Stormclaw Whirlwind

encounters.trigger: Step onto the unstable lava rock

pickup.name: Obsidian Core
pickup.effect: Obsidian Core

encounters.trigger: Push the Magma Warden off the edge

pickup.name: none
pickup.effect: none

encounters.trigger: Trigger the rockfall by damaging the Behemoth

boss.name: Ash Maw
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Ash Maw by exploiting the weakness from the obsidian core

level.objective: Reach the heart of the volcano and defeat Ash Maw

level.setting: A whimsical volcanic cave filled with colorful lava geysers, floating embers, and playful lava creatures.

enemy.name: Fire Lizard
enemy.weakness: The Fire Lizard is weak to the player's pet's claw attacks.

encounters.hazard: The ground is cracked and unstable. Stepping on it may cause lava bursts.

pickup.name: Volcanic Ember
pickup.effect: You find a glowing stone. It radiates heat. This is the Volcanic Ember.

encounters.trigger: You hear the screech of a lizard. The Fire Lizard attacks.

enemy.name: Steam Stalker
enemy.weakness: The Steam Stalker is weak to the Volcanic Ember, which you now carry.

encounters.hazard: Steam vents emit clouds that reduce visibility and damage the player over time.

pickup.name: Beast Resilience Charm
pickup.effect: You find a pet charm. Your beast becomes more resilient in the heat.

encounters.trigger: The steam vents grow louder. A Steam Stalker emerges from the mist.

enemy.name: Magma Warden
enemy.weakness: The Magma Warden is weak to the Beast Resilience Charm, which increases your pet's resistance and damage output.

encounters.hazard: The ground is covered in molten rock. Your pet may become sluggish if not careful.

pickup.name: Flameheart Gem
pickup.effect: You find a glowing gemstone. Your beast gains a fiery aura and increased attack speed.

encounters.trigger: A deep rumbling shakes the chamber. The Magma Warden, guardian of the core, rises to challenge you.

boss.name: Lava Golem
boss.weakness: The Lava Golem is weak to the Volcanic Ember, an item you acquired earlier in the cave.

level.objective: Navigate the volcanic cave and defeat the Lava Golem at the core.
level.reward: A powerful new pet ability: Flamefang, allowing your beast to unleash fiery attacks.

level.theme: Volcanic time-temple, where ancient guardians protect a powerful source of time magic.
level.setting: A serene volcanic realm, where time flows differently. Rivers of magma flow alongside glowing moss and crystalline formations that pulse with energy. The air is thick with a calm, almost meditative hum.

pickup.name: Chronomancer's Hourglass
pickup.effect: Unlocks Hourglass for time manipulation.

encounters.trigger: Awakened by the player's arrival, the Ash Wraith attacks to slow the intruder.

pickup.name: Chronomancer's Hourglass Upgrade
pickup.effect: Boosts time manipulation duration by 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The Lava Warden, seeing the Hourglass, becomes enraged and seeks to destroy it.

pickup.name: Chronoglass Shard
pickup.effect: Drops Chronoglass Shard, a key to defeating Eonfire.

encounters.trigger: The Herald recognizes the player's strength and activates the Time Rifts to draw the player to the boss.

level.objective: Navigate through the volcanic realm, mastering time to overcome the trials and defeat Eonfire.
level.reward: Access to the Chronomancer's Archive and the ability to manipulate time freely.

level.setting: A floating celestial realm with glowing stardust and ancient, floating spires that hum with divine energy. The sky is a vast expanse of stars and swirling galaxies, creating a peaceful but ethereal atmosphere.

enemy.name: Celestial Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Holy Light (obtained from the first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Floating debris that can knock the paladin off balance, reducing defense temporarily.

pickup.name: Lumen Crystals
pickup.effect: Restores 20% of player's health and grants a temporary buff of 'Holy Light' that deals 20% additional damage to enemies with celestial attributes.

encounters.trigger: The player must use the Celestial Aegis to break the barrier enclosing the Sentinel, revealing the next path to the Celestial Core.

encounters.hazard: A shifting platform that moves unpredictably, making it hard to strike the enemy effectively.

pickup.name: Echo of the Cosmos
pickup.effect: Grants the player the ability to reflect celestial energy back at enemies, increasing attack power by 25% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The Guardian of the Veil must be weakened by using the 'Holy Light' from the first encounter to disrupt its energy shield, allowing the player to proceed to the final chamber.

encounters.hazard: A field of gravitational pulses that pull the player into the air, making it harder to strike the enemy.

pickup.name: Celestial Aegis
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Celestial Aegis, a powerful weapon that channels the player's divine energy and is the only weapon capable of damaging the Hollow Star.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Warden, the chamber opens up, revealing the Hollow Star itself. The player must now face the final boss with the Celestial Aegis equipped.

boss.name: The Hollow Star
boss.weakness: Celestial Aegis (obtained from the third encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Hollow Star by striking its core with the Celestial Aegis

level.objective: Travel through the celestial spires, defeat three celestial guardians, and finally vanquish the Hollow Star, restoring balance to the heavens.

level.theme: Mysterious - the level is filled with cryptic inscriptions, shifting landscapes, and echoes of voices from the past and future.
level.setting: Celestial - a realm where time is a physical force, and the sky is filled with swirling constellations that shift and change with every passing second.
level.player_weapon: Chrono-Blade - a weapon that can slow time, reflect attacks, and manipulate temporal fields.

encounters.location: The Veil of Ages - a fragmented corridor of frozen time where moments repeat endlessly.

enemy.name: Echo-Drone
enemy.weakness: The Echo-Drone is vulnerable to the player's weapon when it is in temporal stasis, a state that can be triggered by using the player's Time Distortion ability.

encounters.hazard: A shifting temporal field reduces the player's movement speed and increases damage taken from the Echo-Drone by 20%.

pickup.name: Hourglass Lens
pickup.effect: The player discovers a small, glowing crystal known as the Hourglass Lens, which allows them to see and manipulate time briefly.

encounters.trigger: The Echo-Drone is guarding the entrance to the next section, and defeating it reveals a path through the temporal field.

encounters.location: The Clockwork Ruins - a shattered time machine filled with shifting gears and floating debris.

enemy.name: Chrono-Sentinel
enemy.weakness: The Chrono-Sentinel is vulnerable to attacks that bypass its temporal shields, which can be bypassed by using the Hourglass Lens to reveal its core.

encounters.hazard: A collapsing time loop causes random rewinds of 5 seconds, resetting the player's position if they fail a critical action.

pickup.name: Temporal Energy Core
pickup.effect: The player finds a temporal energy core that temporarily boosts the player's weapon damage by 25% for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Chrono-Sentinel, the player activates a long-dormant time portal that leads to the final encounter.

encounters.location: The Fractured Expanse - a battlefield of shattered time where reality shifts unpredictably.

enemy.name: The Timeless Warden
enemy.weakness: The Timeless Warden cannot resist attacks that are reflected back through time, which can be achieved by using the Temporal Energy Core to amplify the player's weapon's time reflection ability.

encounters.hazard: The area is surrounded by unstable time rifts that randomly teleport the player to a different location on the map.

pickup.name: Chrono-Anchor
pickup.effect: The player finds a hidden relic known as the Chrono-Anchor, which grants a short-lived shield that reflects all incoming damage back to enemies.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Timeless Warden causes a massive time distortion, which opens a portal to the Chrono-Warden’s domain.

boss.name: The Chrono-Warden
boss.weakness: Temporal instability; damage is doubled if the player uses the Hourglass Lens during a phase shift.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Chrono-Warden by exploiting his temporal instability, using the Hourglass Lens you found in the final encounter.

level.objective: Navigate through the celestial realm of time, overcoming temporal guardians and unlocking ancient relics to ultimately defeat the Chrono-Warden, who is the guardian of time itself.
level.reward: A permanent ability to manipulate time for 10 seconds, allowing the player to rewind or fast-forward moments, and a glowing Chrono-Relic that increases all time-based abilities by 30%.

level.theme: Celestial ruin, cosmic horror, and the battle for existence in the void.
level.setting: A desolate, crumbling space station orbiting a black hole. The sky pulses with eerie violet light, and the air is thick with the scent of burnt ozone and cosmic decay.

encounters.hazard: Void Gravity Fields - gravity pulls player toward the center of the arena, increasing fall damage

pickup.name: Void Dagger
pickup.effect: Grants the player the 'Void Dagger' weapon, which can pierce through the Wraith’s energy shield.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Wraith, a rift opens in the sky, revealing the first steps of the Eclipse Path.

encounters.hazard: Luminous Fractures - the arena is filled with glowing cracks that deal damage over time if stood on for more than 3 seconds

pickup.name: Celestial Essence
pickup.effect: Grants the player a vial of Celestial Essence that can be used to overload the Sentinel’s core.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Sentinel, the fractures coalesce into a glowing path, leading toward the heart of the Eclipse.

encounters.hazard: Void Pulse - periodic energy waves that knock the player back and reduce stamina

pickup.name: Celestial Shroud
pickup.effect: Grants the player the 'Celestial Shroud', a shield that can absorb and redirect the Eclipse Reaver’s energy attacks.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Reaver, the core begins to destabilize, revealing the presence of The Hollow Eclipse, the final threat.

boss.name: The Hollow Eclipse
boss.weakness: Celestial Shroud (pickup from the third encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Hollow Eclipse by exploiting its vulnerability to the Celestial Shroud.

level.objective: Navigate through the celestial ruins of a dying star, defeating three increasingly powerful enemies to reach The Hollow Eclipse, the heart of the cosmic anomaly.
level.reward: The Celestial Shroud and the Void Dagger, allowing the player to survive in the void and become a true Shadowblade of the stars.

level.setting: A surreal, floating realm of stars, mirrors, and shifting landscapes, where gravity bends and time flows in loops.

pickup.name: Celestial Lens
pickup.effect: You find a Celestial Lens that magnifies your illusions and makes them more vivid.

encounters.trigger: A glowing starling flits through the air, leaving a trail of light that lures you forward into the Celestial Glade.

pickup.name: Mirror of Illusion
pickup.effect: You uncover a broken mirror that reflects your illusions back at you. It can be reforged into the Mirror of Illusion.

encounters.trigger: The Celestial Lens causes the reflections in the Glade to distort. Following them leads you to the Hall of Echoes.

pickup.name: Celestial Shard
pickup.effect: A shard of light embedded in the Sentinel’s core glows when you use the Mirror of Illusion. It powers your final weapon.

encounters.trigger: The Hall of Echoes shimmers with light, drawing you toward the Celestial Spire where the Starweaver awaits.

boss.name: The Starweaver
boss.weakness: Celestial Lens and Mirror of Illusion
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Starweaver by exploiting the Celestial Lens and the Mirror of Illusion.

level.objective: Navigate through the whimsical celestial realm, defeating illusions and gathering mystical artifacts to weaken the Starweaver.

level.setting: A chaotic, ever-shifting celestial realm where stars collide, black holes swirl, and cosmic storms rage uncontrollably

pickup.name: Celestial Compass
pickup.effect: Reveals the location of the next encounter

encounters.trigger: Stormcaller activates their lightning bolt on the Vortex Wraith, causing a chain reaction that destabilizes the gravitational field.

pickup.name: Spatial Rift Lens
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to manipulate spatial rifts

encounters.trigger: The Void Serpent's presence warps the starfield, creating unstable rifts that lead to the next location.

pickup.name: Celestial Prism
pickup.effect: Grants the Celestial Prism, a powerful crystal that channels cosmic energy

encounters.trigger: The Nebula Harbinger's power intensifies the celestial storm, drawing the player closer to the Maelstrom's core.

boss.name: The Astral Maelstrom
boss.weakness: Celestial Prism (acquired in the final encounter)

level.objective: Defeat the Maelstrom by exploiting the weaknesses revealed in each encounter
level.reward: Celestial Crown - grants immunity to gravitational hazards and boosts storm abilities by 50%

level.theme: Desolation and mystery, where the player must survive in a world slowly unraveling from the void.
level.setting: A vast, broken celestial plane where the sky is black and stars flicker erratically. Craters and shattered monoliths litter the landscape, and the wind carries the sound of distant echoes.

enemy.name: Void Warden
enemy.weakness: The player's Celestial Bow, which can pierce the Void Warden's shield with its radiant energy arrows.

encounters.hazard: Area of Effect Void Pulse that reduces player stamina by 30% for 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Starlight Compass
pickup.effect: Reveals the location of the Celestial Core Pickup.

encounters.trigger: Player must destroy the Void Warden to unlock the path to the Celestial Core Pickup.

enemy.name: Echoing Shade
enemy.weakness: The Celestial Core Pickup, which disrupts the Echoing Shade’s mirage form and makes it vulnerable.

encounters.hazard: Mirror Illusions that confuse the player and cause them to take damage from their own attacks for 3 seconds.

pickup.name: Celestial Core
pickup.effect: Grants the player the Celestial Core Pickup, which can be used to disrupt the final boss’s void armor.

encounters.trigger: The Starlight Compass leads the player to this area, but the Echoing Shade must be defeated to obtain the Celestial Core Pickup.

enemy.name: Veil Maw
enemy.weakness: The player's Celestial Bow, which can fire concentrated energy bursts to bypass the Veil Maw’s energy shields.

encounters.hazard: Gravity Well that pulls the player into a slow-motion vortex, increasing damage taken by 50% for 4 seconds.

pickup.name: Void Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks a shortcut path to the final boss chamber.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Veil Maw with the Celestial Bow allows the player to obtain the Void Key, which opens the door to the Hollow Sentinel’s chamber.

boss.name: The Hollow Sentinel
boss.weakness: The Celestial Core Pickup, which emits a radiant energy that disrupts the boss's void-based armor.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Hollow Sentinel by exploiting the Celestial Core Pickup obtained earlier.

level.objective: Navigate through the desolate celestial ruins, defeat three enemies using the Celestial Bow and the Celestial Core Pickup, and finally defeat the Hollow Sentinel with the Celestial Core Pickup.
level.reward: Celestial Armor Set and a Celestial Token to unlock a new celestial zone.

level.theme: A journey through forgotten cosmic ruins, haunted by the remnants of celestial guardians, culminating in a confrontation with the last protector of the realm.
level.setting: A fractured celestial plane, filled with crystalline structures, shifting constellations, and echoes of ancient cosmic energies.

enemy.name: Shattered Sentinel
enemy.weakness: The Shattered Sentinel is vulnerable to your Arcane Forge, which deals elemental damage.

encounters.hazard: A storm of fractured starlight damages the player on a failed save.

pickup.name: Echo of the Oracle
pickup.effect: You find the 'Echo of the Oracle' — a mysterious crystal that grants +2 to all skill checks for 3 turns.

encounters.trigger: Upon entering the Crystalline Expanse, the ground begins to crack and glow with unstable energy, drawing the attention of the Shattered Sentinel.

enemy.name: Veilborn Harbinger
enemy.weakness: The Veilborn Harbinger is vulnerable to the 'Echo of the Oracle' found in the previous encounter, which disrupts its ethereal form.

encounters.hazard: A temporal rift appears, causing the player to take damage and possibly be trapped in a loop for 1 turn.

pickup.name: Starbound Core
pickup.effect: You recover the 'Starbound Core' — a glowing artifact that temporarily enhances your Arcane Forge with a powerful celestial infusion.

encounters.trigger: Following the Veilborn Harbinger's defeat, the rift collapses, revealing a hidden chamber where the Starbound Core lies waiting.

enemy.name: Oracle of Echoes
enemy.weakness: The Oracle of Echoes is vulnerable to the 'Starbound Core' found in the previous encounter, which allows it to be damaged by celestial energy.

encounters.hazard: The Oracle of Echoes summons a hallucinogenic mist, which can cause confusion and temporary blindness.

pickup.name: Celestial Warden's Key
pickup.effect: You acquire the 'Celestial Warden’s Key' — a shimmering key that unlocks the path to the final chamber.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Oracle of Echoes, the Sanctum trembles and a hidden door is revealed, sealed by the Celestial Warden’s Key.

boss.name: Celestial Warden
boss.weakness: The Celestial Warden is vulnerable to the 'Starbound Core' artifact, which you found during the final encounter with the Oracle of Echoes.

level.objective: Navigate through the eerie celestial landscapes, overcome the three guardians, and confront the Celestial Warden.
level.reward: Celestial Warden's Seal — a powerful artifact that allows the player to create celestial constructs in future battles.

level.setting: A derelict orbital station in a chaotic asteroid field, surrounded by gravitational tides and unstable energy flows.

enemy.name: Tethered Drone
enemy.weakness: The Tethered Drone is vulnerable to electromagnetic pulses. A Gravitic Disruptor Pickup is dropped upon defeat.

pickup.name: Gravitic Disruptor Pickup
pickup.effect: Gravitic Disruptor Pickup: Enhances your weapon’s ability to target gravitational anomalies.

encounters.trigger: The Gravitational Tether pulls the player into the core of the station. Defeat the Tethered Drone to weaken the tether, allowing progression.

enemy.name: Crystalline Sentinel
enemy.weakness: The Crystalline Sentinel is weak to precision strikes. A Quantum Capacitor is dropped upon defeat.

pickup.name: Quantum Capacitor
pickup.effect: Quantum Capacitor: Required to power the Gravitic Disruptor against the boss.

encounters.trigger: After escaping the Gravitational Tether, the player enters the Energy Core Chamber. The Crystalline Sentinel is guarding the chamber, and its defeat reveals the Quantum Capacitor.

enemy.name: Graviton Construct
enemy.weakness: The Graviton Construct is weak to the Gravitic Disruptor Pickup from the first encounter.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None

encounters.trigger: The Quantum Capacitor powers the room’s gravitational stabilizers, causing the Graviton Construct to activate. Defeating it with the Gravitic Disruptor Pickup will unlock the path to the boss.

boss.name: The Graviton Core
boss.weakness: The Graviton Core is vulnerable to the Gravitic Disruptor, which can only be activated with the Quantum Capacitor obtained in the final encounter.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Graviton Core by activating the Gravitic Disruptor with the Quantum Capacitor.

level.objective: Reach the Graviton Core and destroy it using the Gravitic Disruptor and Quantum Capacitor.
level.reward: Graviton Core destroyed; the station stabilizes.
